items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Baby Bell was one of the old great attempts of all time.

ctx.x: Baby Bell was one of the old great attempts of all time. But he loved musicians, and he used to

let Earl have money to sustain himself. And so I said, Earl, Ed Fox was billing Earl Hines, he wasn't billing Ed Fox. I said you have the name, all we got to do man is to start to sending out wires and writing letters to all of those people you've played for, and you get those deposits in. I says I'll whip the band, me and Billy Eckstein will whip the band back together for you, and hell, we can go on and play. So he says, yeah, you could do that, I says, sure. So Billy Eckstein and myself set out to get this…
